caption.instagram:
Why a new goal feels better than finishing the old one (and how to stop starting over).

Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, reason #28: the new goal. Week six of guitar is hard chords and sore fingers. Then a Spanish video gives you the buzz back. A new goal puts you back at zero, where every step feels huge, and planning feels like progress even though nothing is done.

The fix:
- Old goal first: give it its next finish line (play one full song this month)
- New goal: on a later list
- Write its start date (Spanish: Dec 1)

Which goal did you start, then replace? Tell me below.
